ui.nsfwHelp: Off by default. Includes workplace language that may not belong in the boardroom.
ui.previewEmptyHelp: Set your parameters, then generate a calendar worthy of a quarterly retrospective.
ui.noSavedHelp: Refreshes start fresh. Your grind remains ephemeral by design.

errors.dateOrder: End date must be on or after the start date.
errors.range: Choose a range of 31 calendar days or fewer.
errors.workStart: Enter a valid work start time.
errors.workEnd: End time must be after start time.
errors.blockOrder: Minimum block must not exceed maximum block.
errors.blockRange: Blocks must be between 15 and 240 minutes.
errors.breakEvery: Break cadence must be between 0 and 480 minutes.
errors.breakDuration: Break length must be between 0 and 120 minutes.
errors.lunchOrder: Lunch must end after it starts.
errors.lunchWindow: Lunch must sit inside the work window.
errors.noEntries: Those filters found no eligible blocks. Try a broader theme, lower intensity, or allow spicy content.
errors.tooMany: This setup would create more than 250 events. Narrow the dates or work window.
errors.catalog: The content catalog could not be loaded. No partial schedule was created.
